prompt: Which country was affected by Black Monday and experienced a prolonged recession, continuing its decline for an extended period after other global markets had recovered?
answer: Japan. It was affected by the 1987 Black Monday shock and then suffered a prolonged downturn after its asset-price bubble burst in the early 1990s—declining long after many other global markets had recovered.
